description: Extends F1a basin model with turbine efficiency vs head ratio, seawater density (T/S) correction, tidal range variability (spring/neap cycle), and pumping mode energy gain.

unit.name: Generic Tidal Lagoon — Bidirectional (Swansea Bay class)
unit.source: Aggidis & Feather (2012) Ocean Eng. 40:10-17; Xiao et al. (2020) Renew. Energy; Tidal Lagoon Power (2015) Scoping Report; Baker (1991) Tidal Power, Peter Peregrinus.

eta_peak.note: Peak plant efficiency at design head; bidirectional lagoon turbines ~25-30%

h_min_operation.note: Minimum head differential for turbine operation

k_head_efficiency.note: Head-efficiency curvature coefficient; eta(h) = eta_peak*(1 - k*(h/h_design-1)^2)

pumping_gain_fraction.note: Energy gain fraction from pumping water into lagoon at high tide (~7% additional energy)

spring_neap_amplitude.note: Relative amplitude variation from spring (max) to neap (min): h_spring = h_design*(1+0.30), h_neap = h_design*(1-0.30)
